Private durable metadata, owner/mode/symlink checks, missing-store failure and fresh bearer mapped to stable principal/workspace/launch are specified.

Exact raw HTTP bytes plus method/route replace ambiguous canonical serialization; deterministic rejection receipts and indefinite retention avoid expiration/cleanup races. Existing authorized receipt lookup precedes validation and quota.
Workspace row serializes policy installation, reservation and final CAS. Final nonce and policy checks fence stale validation frames; policy mismatch requires fresh validation.

blocking_findings.location: wire receipts.quota; workspace fields; admission/finalization protocol
blocking_findings.finding: The64-document hard limit has no reserved_documents counter or explicit final count rejection. With63 existing documents, two CREATE requests can both reserve revision/receipt/byte capacity before either commits.
blocking_findings.resolution: Reserve one document slot for each admitted CREATE under workspace lock, preserving it across takeover and releasing on known terminal outcome, or specify final document_count recheck with a defined deterministic quota outcome. Include revision0 in the4096-revision count; charge exact stored bytes/metadata once and settle reservations atomically. Test63 existing plus two concurrent creates and full-quota replay.

blocking_findings.finding: The full-module-only candidate carries no copy lineage/trivia transfer. Stable IDs identify retained or moved nodes, but fresh IDs alone cannot identify which old comments should be duplicated by a copy. The required copy-comment behavior is underdetermined.
blocking_findings.resolution: Add a closed bounded presentation lineage/map tied to expectedRevision, with explicit source-node to fresh-node copy relationships verified by server and no authority claims, or another concrete complete trivia transport. Define SOURCE-to-BLOCK handling from authoritative source and preserve exact comments through copy/move/delete tests. Do not infer copy from equal text or structurally equal nodes.

blocking_findings.location: main and wire projection map identity; history-copy
blocking_findings.finding: Stored maps still variously bind artifact/revision while revision rows reference immutable artifacts. Copying a historical artifact to a new revision must not retain an authoritative old revision binding or mutate old map bytes.
blocking_findings.resolution: Freeze maps as artifact/source-bound immutable content with revision in the referencing envelope. History-copy revalidates and creates a current-policy checked artifact/new revision, preserving exact span contents when source unchanged, and never rewrites prior artifact maps. Align all main/wire language.

blocking_findings.resolution: Finish connected CandidateValid/module/scope/source/map model and align every transition, bounds and policy mismatch behavior with frozen wire. blocking_findings.location: main/wire resource budgets and parser-spike limitations
blocking_findings.finding: Two validation workers and1024MiB memory remain alongside inherited stricter per-user concurrency1 and512MiB heap. The spike needed8GiB address space and therefore does not validate deployment limits; a numeric memory budget without heap/address-space distinction is ambiguous.
blocking_findings.resolution: Specify global versus per-principal concurrency and shared solve/validate permit accounting, zero queue behavior, heap versus address-space/process bounds and full request/response serialization ceilings. Reuse existing isolated worker policy without relaxing inherited limits. Measure under the actual launcher before claiming budget acceptance; keep500-node latency target open under256-node profile.

nonblocking_implementation_requirements: Preserve method/route/API version identity in active admissions as well as final receipts and checked frames; final nonce checks must also bind operation identity.

Reserve4MiB only after all component ceilings are enforced; artifact1MiB does not imply a1MiB response containing artifact plus JSON/envelope/remapping fits. Construct/bound the complete stored outcome before final transaction.

Availability may leave durable admissions/reservations. Provide explicit retry recovery after verified old worker/process exit, install a fresh nonce under locks and always inspect receipt first. Never use elapsed time as death proof; uncertain old transaction resolution is serialized by the same workspace lock.

Treat all terminal admissions and retained request copies as accounted storage. At quota, GET and existing receipt recovery must remain possible; new mutation rejection is an intentional availability limit.
Replay reports historical receipt success only and never grants current-policy analysis/canonical eligibility. Authorization remains mandatory before receipt disclosure.

Bridge process accepts only server-owned fixed operations/frames; no browser-supplied trusted candidate, DSN, SQL or principal. Inventory migration/create/commit/recovery SQL paths and assert per-client proxy evidence.
